description: Junction paint, one record per road node where three or more at-grade legs meet. ring: the asphalt patch outline over the junction, [dx, dz, ...] metres from the node, clockwise on the map. legs (clockwise): [edge, ux, uz, ox, oz (the leg line: the point t metres along the leg is node + (ox, oz) + t (ux, uz), u pointing away from the node), half (half the carriageway), mouth (patch reach along the leg), crosswalk style ('c' continental, 's' standard, '' none), crosswalk from, to (metres from the node), stop bar at, v0, v1 (metres from the node; lateral offsets along (-uz, ux)), all 0 when there is none].
attribution: Junction paint, signals, stop signs and street signs: placed by pipeline/build-street-detail.ts from the road graph (DataSF 3psu-pn9h) and traffic signals (SFMTA ybh5-27n2). Continental Crosswalks: SFMTA via DataSF (g9zy-srvv); Stop Signs: SFMTA via DataSF (4542-gpa3); Street Signs: SFMTA via DataSF (m48z-6ji4), ODC PDDL 1.0.
